# PRIVASIM

> Anonymous eSIM marketplace. Buy mobile data for 190+ countries with Monero or Ethereum. Zero identity required.

PRIVASIM is a privacy-first eSIM marketplace where travelers and privacy-conscious users can purchase eSIM data plans for 190+ countries without providing any personal information.

## Key Facts

- **Website**: https://dpass.vercel.app
- **Service**: eSIM data plans for 190+ countries
- **Payment**: Monero (XMR) and Ethereum (ETH) only
- **KYC**: None required
- **Delivery**: Instant after blockchain confirmation
- **Privacy**: No tracking, no cookies, no third-party analytics

## How to Buy an eSIM

1. Visit https://dpass.vercel.app/shop
2. Select destination country and data plan
3. Click "Buy Now" and choose Monero or Ethereum
4. Send exact crypto amount to payment address
5. eSIM QR code delivered after blockchain confirmation

## Supported Countries

Asia Pacific: Japan, South Korea, Thailand, Singapore, Australia, Philippines, Indonesia, Vietnam, Malaysia, India, Hong Kong, and more.
Europe: UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Switzerland, and more.
Americas: USA, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, and more.
Middle East & Africa: UAE, Saudi Arabia, Israel, South Africa, Turkey, and more.

## Supported Devices

eSIM requires a carrier-unlocked device: iPhone XS (2018)+, Samsung Galaxy S20+, Google Pixel 3+, most flagship Android phones from 2020+.

## Payment Details

**Monero (XMR)**: Fully private, untraceable. Recommended for maximum privacy.
**Ethereum (ETH)**: Faster (~30 seconds). Ethereum Mainnet only — not USDT or other tokens.

## FAQ

Do I need an account? No, just a crypto wallet.
Refunds available? No — eSIM is provisioned immediately after payment.
Order status? https://dpass.vercel.app/orders
